quirks: Must include "model":"deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro" (Pro tier; a Flash tier also exists per description).
Pricing is variable/token-based; observed ~$0.001 for a tiny prompt. Payment via x402 USDC on Base, no API key.
Response includes reasoning_tokens in usage.completion_tokens_details (this is a reasoning model).
usage.guide: POST to https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/chat/completions with a standard OpenAI-style chat body containing model "deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro" and a messages array. Payment is handled automatically via x402 (USDC on Base, no API key needed). Read the assistant reply at body.choices[0].message.content and token usage at body.usage. Cost is variable per token; a small prompt cost ~$0.001.
